name: Apothecarium
summary: In the Undercity’s southwest quarter, the Apothecarium drives the Royal Apothecary Society’s work. Under Master Apothecary Faranell, Forsaken alchemists pursue plagues, toxins, and engineered horrors for Lady Sylvanas’s campaign against the living and the Scourge.

sections.title: Chamber of Horrors
sections.body: The Apothecarium fills the Undercity’s southwestern terrace with vats, dissection tables, and chemical fumes. Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society’s work there, studying mortality and rot. Alchemists and surgeons experiment with tissue grafts and vivisection, and assemble mighty abominations. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner has charged them with creating a plague that can eradicate both the Scourge and the lingering human presence across Lordaeron.

sections.title: Center of Forsaken Alchemy
sections.body: The quarter draws alchemists and herbalists from across the Horde in the Eastern Kingdoms. Initiates and masters gather beside toxic canals to distill concoctions, study botanical blights, and seek counsel from master practitioners.

faq.q: What is the Apothecarium used for?
faq.answer: The Apothecarium is where the Royal Apothecary Society researches and makes its wares. Forsaken alchemists brew experimental poisons, refine the New Plague, build abominations, and teach alchemy and herbalism there.
Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Apothecarium and its researchers. As chief scientist of the Royal Apothecary Society, he works with Queen Sylvanas Windrunner’s full authority and patronage.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society trying to create?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society seeks to create a lethal New Plague. It is meant to destroy the Lich King’s Scourge forces and the living human resistance contesting Forsaken territory in Lordaeron.
Yes. The Apothecarium is the Undercity’s main hub for alchemists and herbalists, with advanced trainers along its walkways and in its chambers.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, the Apothecarium produces the chemical and stitched weapons they need to hold Lordaeron against overwhelming enemies.
As a herbalist, you supply the Royal Apothecary Society’s distillers with rare, blighted flora gathered from the northern kingdoms’ ruins.
